programmes.t: Scottie Scheffler Wins 2024 Arnold Palmer Invitational
programmes.d: Scottie Scheffler captures his first victory of the 2024 FedExCup Season after winning the Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard. Scheffler won by five strokes, shooting 15-under par for the tournament, after rounds of 70-67-70-66.

programmes.t: Stephan Jaeger Wins the 2024 Texas Children's
programmes.d: Stephan Jaeger captures his first PGA TOUR victory after winning the 2024 Texas Children's Houston Open. Jaeger shot rounds of 69-66-66-67 to finish 12-under par.

programmes.t: United States Team Wins 2024 Presidents Cup
programmes.d: The United States Team defeated the International Team in the 2024 Presidents Cup, with a final score of 18.5-11.5, in the 10th consecutive Presidents Cup victory for the United States.

programmes.t: Rory McIlroy Wins the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am
programmes.d: Northern Irishman Rory McIlroy won his 2025 season debut with a 21-under 267 (66-70-65-66), good for a two-shot victory and his 27th on the PGA TOUR.
